heroSlides.title: Meet SAIL
heroSlides.text: A newly launched PUC-Rio lab dedicated to research, innovation, and talent development in Software Engineering and AI Engineering.

heroSlides.title: Software & AI Engineering Lab
heroSlides.text: We produce knowledge and train people to build software and AI systems that are more effective, reliable, and responsible.

heroSlides.title: Tradition and Excellence
heroSlides.text: SAIL is part of PUC-Rio's Graduate Program in Informatics, an internationally recognized program with CAPES 7, the highest evaluation level.

heroSlides.title: Scientific Leadership
heroSlides.text: SAIL is led by Marcos Kalinowski, an internationally recognized Software Engineering researcher with strong experience in industry-driven R&D.

heroSlides.title: Research Areas
heroSlides.text: We investigate Human Aspects, AI Engineering, Experimental Software Engineering, and Artificial Intelligence for Software Engineering.

heroSlides.title: Collaboration Network
heroSlides.text: SAIL connects PUC-Rio, ISERN, Instituto Kunumi, leading universities, research centers, and industry partners in impactful projects.

heroSlides.title: Follow SAIL
heroSlides.text: Follow our research, projects, and contributions to the future of Software Engineering and Artificial Intelligence.
